label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: World Wide Tech lead
items.text: Ben James leads the World Wide Technology Championship at 21-under through one hole in the final round, holding a four-shot advantage over Ryan Gerard at 17-under.

items.headline: Rahm leads Abu Dhabi
items.text: Jon Rahm leads the Abu Dhabi Aldar Championship with a final-round 67, finishing two shots ahead of Tyrrell Hatton in his first DP World Tour start after leaving LIV Golf.

items.headline: Hatton secures Dubai spot
items.text: Tyrrell Hatton's runner-up finish at Abu Dhabi secured his entry into next week's DP World Tour Championship in Dubai.
